data.description:
Until the start of your next turn, when a target succeeds on a Check that includes @DATA[key.attributeLocal] @ICON[@DATA[key.attribute]] and that Check allows them to advance or turn back a Clock, they may fill or erase 1 additional section of that Clock.

Targets Gain: @EFFECT[pfu-energetic-tone-dex], @EFFECT[pfu-energetic-tone-ins], @EFFECT[pfu-energetic-tone-mig], or @EFFECT[pfu-energetic-tone-wlp]
